item.title: azure: Announcing: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta
item.description:
Azure Databricks is now available in Beta on Microsoft Azure Government. It provides the Databricks data and AI platform for U.S. public sector agencies and partners as a first-party Azure service.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Databricks Private network gateway
item.description:
Azure Databricks Private network gateway is now in Public Preview. It lets serverless compute reach resources in your VNet and transitively connected networks through a single managed gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates
